test_title: PYST 30: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A change which is the result of an act or some cause
solution: The correct answer is '**Effect**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Effect**'. • It means 'a change that is caused by something; a result'. (प्रभाव; परिणाम) • *Example: the **effects** of acid rain on the lakes and forests...* **Correct Answer:__** *Effect.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Addition**: adding something, especially two or more numbers. (जोड़ने की क्रिया, विशेषतः संख्‍याओं को; संयोजन, योग) • **Affect**: make somebody/something change in a particular way; to influence somebody/something. (किसी वस्‍तु या व्‍यक्ति के व्‍यवहार को प्रभावित करना; असर डालना) • **Product**: something that is made in a factory or that is formed naturally. (कारख़ाने में निर्मित या प्राकृतिक प्रक्रिया से बनी वस्‍तु) 40:T79e, The correct answer is** 'find another one route'.**
